title: Annual multi-event histories (age, social rank, canine distemper status) of 815 male spotted hyenas, Serengeti National Park, 1990-2010
creator: Benhaiem, Sarah; Marescot, Lucile; Gimenez, Olivier; Hofer, Heribert; Lebreton, Jean-Dominique; Olarte-Castillo, Ximena A.
citation: Benhaiem, S., Marescot, L., Gimenez, O., Hofer, H., Lebreton, J.-D., & Olarte-Castillo, X. A. (2018). Capture-Mark-Recapture (CMR) datasets of Serengeti spotted hyenas infected with CDV [Dataset]. figshare. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.5840970.v1
abstract: Yearly encounter histories of individually known male spotted hyenas in three Serengeti clans, 1990-2010, each observation coded by age class, social rank and canine distemper virus (CDV) infection status (susceptible, infected, recovered, or unknown), used in a multi-event capture-recapture model of the fitness costs of CDV infection by social status.
samplingProtocol: Long-term individual-based monitoring of clan members, identified by their spot patterns, with non-invasive sampling to determine CDV infection status; observations pooled to one annual occasion and coded by age class, rank and infection status.
designNote: Multi-event: y is the observed event; codes with infection status Unknown are observations whose CDV status was not determined.
geographicCoverage: Serengeti National Park, Tanzania (no locations deposited)

notShipped.model_output: the paper's survival, breeding and infection-transition estimates

notes: Males only; the other sex is marescot_2018_serengeti_hyena_f_ms. Individuals first recorded as cubs have rows from that year; others from 1990 (E4.4).
